mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months, persistent labor market weakness triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE has been above 7.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based demand contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns, with Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO above 102.0 for three months), supply-side expansion supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO has been above 102.0 for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP growth rate above 2.0% signals strong economic momentum that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.0%, it signals rising inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth and rising unemployment indicates labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative returns, with Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), accommodative monetary policy supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE has been above 7.0% for two consecutive months.
